rationale: The change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly affects FR-7.2.2, while the Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged. In the baseline, H1-ORR2 is the only ORR that depends on FR-7.2.2 via H1-A2 and H1-RC2, which require revalidation if the object-category scheme or related information changes. H1-ORR1 and H1-ORR3 are not implicated because obstacle presence and ego-object spatial information are stated to remain unchanged.
